title: Analysis code for: Routine laboratory data for predicting intensive care unit transfer
description: Analysis pipeline reproducing every estimate reported in a retrospective prediction model study of 30-day intensive care unit transfer based on routine laboratory data: cohort construction, L1-penalised logistic regression at the natural prevalence, temporal validation, six classes of sensitivity analysis, the complete 30-day follow-up analysis, and the Kaplan-Meier correction for administrative censoring. The package contains code only; record-level data are not included.
